checks.name: progression_actually_progresses
checks.detail: RPE/intensity guidance ramps weeks 1-2 -> 3-5 -> 7-8, with a genuine volume reduction (one fewer set per exercise) in the week-6 deload rather than a cosmetic label.

checks.name: progression_rate_appropriate_for_beginner
checks.detail: Guidance is qualitative (RPE + 'increase when you hit the top of the range twice') rather than prescribing specific absolute loads the system can't know -- appropriate for an unsupervised beginner program.
